Yes—B gives you later morning starts:

- A: Studio Monday/Wednesday, 8–9:15 a.m.
- B: Studio Tuesday/Thursday, 10–11:40 a.m., leaving 20 minutes before your noon work shift.

B avoids all 8 a.m. classes, but spreads classes across four weekdays instead of A’s three. Your Monday 10 a.m. class and Thursday 5:30–6:20 p.m. lab remain the same.

Both meet your requirements at 13 credits. I favor B if avoiding early starts matters most and the transition to work is practical.

Saved Plan A and your current enrollment remain unchanged.
